template: Open {{v2}} in the browser. If a login page appears, sign in with login '{{v3}}' and password {{v4}} (type the password text exactly as provided, do not guess). If a login page appears, sign in with login 'admin' and password {{env:APP_PASSWORD}} (type the password text exactly as provided, do not guess). Then create a new customer in Odoo: a contact named 'fwod96-n1 Bench Customer' with its City field set to 'Benchville'.
